content.title: Last Time Michigan Men’s Basketball Won the National Championship
content.text: Apr 04, 2026, 2:34 PM min read (AP Photo/Erin Hooley) Entering the 2026 men’s Final Four, Michigan basketball odds are the short shot in BetMGM’s March Madness odds market. A win for Dusty May and the Wolverines would give Michigan fans their first men’s basketball championship in more than 30 years. Last Time Michigan Men’s Basketball Won the National Championship Michigan men’s basketball has won only one national championship, back in 1989. The Wolverines won an unlikely national championship in ‘89 after Steve Fisher was elevated to the head coach position during the final days of the regular season. Last Time Michigan Men’s Basketball Played In the National Championship Game Michigan has played in the championship game four times since winning the title in 1989, with the most recent appearance coming in 2018. The Wolverines are 0-4 in those games. Last Time Michigan Men’s Basketball Made the Final Four Michigan’s last Final Four was in 2018. Overall, the Wolverines have been to the men’s Final Four nine times.
